name: P14
title: Asthma Long-term Control Pathway
description: The patient completes a general health questionnaire every day. Then respiratory parameters are monitored for 30 minutes. If abnormal respiratory parameters are detected, the practitioner is alerted urgently. Otherwise, the patient is educated on correct inhaler use.
